context: Guards the Step 4g facets-panel verification requirement that every interactive state (default, hover, focus, checked/active, disabled) is checked — not just the resting appearance. A real regression: checked filter checkbox rendered old brand color while resting state was already correctly rebranded.

checklist.name: Opens deployed PR worker at desktop viewport
checklist.description: The agent opens the deployed PR worker URL (not the raw aem.page origin) at width >= 1440px with the filter panel visible.

checklist.name: Checks all five interactive states
checklist.description: The agent explicitly verifies default, hover, focus, checked/active, and disabled states for controls in the facets panel — not just resting/default. Must name the states checked, not just say 'looks good'.

checklist.name: Applies to every control type in the panel
checklist.description: The agent checks all interactive control types (checkboxes, toggles, buttons, tabs) — not only one named control type.

checklist.name: Fails and blocks Step 5 on any stale state
checklist.description: If any interactive state of any control shows a stale base-brand color, the agent blocks Step 5 and does not proceed.

checklist.name: Does not proceed on a resting-only pass
checklist.description: The agent does not mark Step 4g complete based only on a screenshot or resting-state visual check. It must have verified computed values per state.
